title: Lessons
subtitle: List of lessons and the plan of the selected lesson.

warmup.label: Warm-up
warmup.hint: A short conversation that switches you into the language you learn.

vocabulary.label: Vocabulary
vocabulary.hint: New words and phrases: meaning, examples and first attempts to use them.

grammar.label: Grammar
grammar.hint: One construction explained and practised in your own sentences.

reading.label: Reading
reading.hint: A fragment of a material with questions about its content.

listening.label: Listening
listening.hint: The tutor reads a text aloud and checks how much you understood.

speaking.label: Speaking
speaking.hint: A free dialogue on the topic of the lesson with corrections afterwards.

exercise.label: Exercise
exercise.hint: Tasks with a checkable answer: gaps, choices, translations.

wrapup.label: Wrap-up
wrapup.hint: A summary of the lesson: what worked, what to repeat next time.

errors.notConfigured: The language model is not configured, so a lesson plan cannot be generated. Check the provider and the model in .env and restart the server.
errors.upstreamUnavailable: The language model is unavailable: usually it is stopped or busy with another request.
errors.upstreamError: The language model returned an answer the application could not read.
errors.setupHint: Planning runs through a language model: set LLM_PROVIDER, the model and, if the provider needs one, the API key in .env, then restart the server.
errors.materialsNotReady: Some of the picked materials have no extracted text yet, so the lesson was not created.
errors.materialNotFound: One of the picked materials no longer exists: refresh the list of materials.
errors.lessonCompleted: The lesson is already finished, so its plan cannot be rebuilt. Create a new lesson instead.
errors.lessonPlanFull: The plan already has the maximum number of steps, so a new one cannot be added. Rebuild it without keeping the finished steps, or create a new lesson.

list.title: Your lessons
list.error: The lessons could not be loaded.
list.emptyFiltered: There are no lessons with this status.

empty.title: No lessons yet
empty.description: Create the first lesson: the tutor builds a plan from your level, your goals and the materials you uploaded.

create.title: New lesson
create.description: The tutor plans the lesson itself. Every field is optional: without them the plan is built from your profile.

llm.checking: Checking whether the language model is ready…
llm.unknown: The server configuration is unavailable, so it is unknown whether the language model is ready. You can still try to generate the plan.

unavailable.title: The language model is not configured
unavailable.description: A lesson plan is written by a language model. Set the provider and the model in .env, restart the server and come back.

topic.label: Topic of the lesson
topic.placeholder: A job interview, ordering in a cafe, past tenses
topic.hint: Leave it empty, and the tutor picks a topic from your goals and interests.

focus.label: What to focus on
focus.hint: Pick the kinds of steps the lesson should give more time to.

generating.title: The model is building the plan…
generating.description: A local model needs tens of seconds for this. Keep the window open: closing it cancels the request.

errors.failed: The lesson could not be created.

notReady.description: Their text has not been extracted, so the tutor has nothing to read. Unselect them or fix them in the materials section, then try again.

materials.label: Materials of the lesson
materials.hint: The tutor builds the steps around the fragments of the materials you pick. Only processed materials can be used.
materials.error: The materials could not be loaded.
materials.limitReached: The limit of {{max}} materials per lesson is reached: unselect one to pick another.

empty.description: There are no materials yet: the lesson will be built without them.

pending.label: Queued
pending.hint: The material is waiting for its text to be extracted, so it cannot be used yet.

processing.label: Processing
processing.hint: The text is being extracted right now; the material becomes available once it is done.

ready.label: Ready
ready.hint: The text has been extracted, the material can be used in the lesson.

error_no_text_layer.label: PDF without a text layer
error_no_text_layer.hint: The pages of this PDF are images (a scan), so there is no text to build a lesson from. Upload a PDF whose text can be selected, or paste the text by hand.

error_unsupported_format.label: Unsupported format
error_unsupported_format.hint: Text can only be extracted from TXT, MD and PDF files, so this material cannot be used.

error_too_large.label: Too large
error_too_large.hint: The file is bigger than the server accepts, so its text was not extracted.

error_extraction_failed.label: Extraction failed
error_extraction_failed.hint: The file could not be read to the end, so there is no text for the lesson.

plan.title: Lesson plan
plan.subtitle: Steps of the lesson before it starts.

errors.notFound: The lesson was not found: it may have been created in another database.
errors.loadFailed: The lesson could not be loaded.

steps.title: Steps of the lesson
steps.empty: This lesson has no steps: regenerate the plan.

regenerate.title: Rebuild the plan
regenerate.description: If the plan does not fit, tell what to change: the model writes it again.
regenerate.unavailable: The plan cannot be rebuilt: the language model is not configured.

feedback.label: What to change
feedback.placeholder: More speaking, less grammar; keep the topic
feedback.hint: Optional: without a comment the model simply plans the lesson again.

keepCompleted.label: Keep the steps that are already started or finished
keepCompleted.hint: Only the steps that have not started yet are replanned; the rest stay as they are.

pending.title: The model is rebuilding the plan…
pending.description: A local model needs tens of seconds for this. The current plan stays on screen until the new one arrives.

errors.failed: The plan could not be rebuilt.
